It then closes the goal with `simpa [nodeValue5131, Sparse.eval] using hc.symm`. That `simpa` call does not use `[*]`, so it does not pull in context hypotheses. The identity holds for every `B : Fin 7 → Basis`, so the binder can be deleted on its own with the proof unchanged. I did not open the definitions of `mixedVector`, `mixedMoment` or `Sparse.eval`. I relied on the `rfl` step compiling as written.
